chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Abi Najran, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The kidney-beans expel the underlying wind.

key_terms.اللُّوبِيَاءِ: Kidney beans or broad beans, a type of legume
key_terms.الْمُسْتَبْطِنَةَ: Hidden, deep, or underlying (referring to the location of the wind)

ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits of kidney beans according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies kidney beans (al-lubiya) as a remedy for expelling hidden winds (al-riyah al-mustabtanah), reflecting the Shia tradition of integrating practical medicine with spiritual guidance. This highlights the concept of 'tibb al-nabawi' where natural foods are viewed not merely as sustenance but as therapeutic agents prescribed by the Imams to address specific internal imbalances.
